info.title: demux
info.description: Route each line of a stream to files or commands by regex — the partition verb for pipes.

options.name: --all
options.description: Broadcast: route to every matching route (default: first-match)

options.name: --append
options.description: File targets append instead of truncate

options.name: --exit-on-child-error
options.description: A watched child's non-zero exit makes demux exit 2

options.name: --field
options.description: Test the regex against column N (1-based) instead of the whole line

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description:
Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
Routes:
--to PATTERN FILE     Route lines matching regex PATTERN to FILE (repeatable).
--exec PATTERN CMD    Route matching lines to a command's stdin (shell-spawned, repeatable).

options.name: --default-exec
options.description:
Unmatched records -> a command. (Omit both -> unmatched -> stdout.)
PATTERN is a bare .NET regex (not slash-delimited). Quote it to protect the shell.
